reserveReview.rationale: The whitepaper specifies at least 30% cash at regulated EU credit institutions and up to 70% euro government MMFs or similar investments. These are policy bounds, not measured weights. The full reserve envelope is therefore one explicitly unclassified basket; no 30/70 allocation is invented. The current product page claims monthly independent reports, but its linked artifact is a smart-contract security audit and the retrieved download inventory exposes no exact-token financial reserve reconciliation. Medium legacy risk records the unresolved permitted-investment basket, not an observed loss.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer whitepaper and product-page reserve eligibility, with no observed cash/investment allocation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No dated portfolio inventory, allocation, named reserve bank, fund identity, maturity schedule or exact-token independent financial reconciliation was retrieved. Corporate financial audit and code audit do not establish reserve assurance.
